title: Repossession and Collateral Recovery State Limits on Voluntary Surrender Fees
content:
State schedule for the voluntary surrender fee under Repossession and Collateral Recovery. The state is the contract state recorded on the borrower's contract in Retail Installment Contracts.

**Rule.** Where the contract's state is one of AL, FL or GA, the class surrender fee is limited to 150.00; where it is one of NC, SC or TN, it is limited to 160.00; in any other state the class surrender fee stands with no state limit.

| Contract state | Limit on the class surrender fee |
|---|---|
| AL, FL, GA | 150.00 |
| NC, SC, TN | 160.00 |
| every other state | none |

## Both sides of each limit (hypothetical class surrender fees)

| Contract state | Class surrender fee | After the state limit |
|---|---|---|
| FL | 1,000.00 | 150.00 |
| TN | 1,000.00 | 160.00 |
| GA | 100.00 | 100.00 (already below the limit) |
| VA | 1,000.00 | 1,000.00 (no state limit) |
